NVIDIA Quadro NVS 140M (G86) - Win98SE native display driver
Build: 3074  (M5.3a - RING-3 DRIVES THE GPU: a persistent GPU channel that user
space submits command streams to, using nv50 indirect-buffer (IB) mode. Verified
on the T61. Builds on M5.2 (VM + heap + fence) and M5.1 (2D engine renders).
Native desktop, OpenGL ICD (software for now), Direct3D + DirectDraw, standby/resume.)

Test commands (MS-DOS Prompt):
  nvprobe gpu2d    - 2D engine fills a VRAM rectangle (in-driver, physical)
  nvprobe vmtest   - fill addressed by a GPU VIRTUAL address (M5.2a)
  nvprobe fence    - VRAM heap BO + GPU writes a sequence via the VM (M5.2b)
  nvprobe submit   - RING-3 builds commands, the GPU executes them (M5.3a)
